title: Claw Care and Seasonal Shedding Tips for Early Summer
description: As summer begins in the Northern Hemisphere, learn how to manage your cat's claw health during the shedding season.
main_content: With the arrival of June, many cats experience increased shedding and claw growth. This blueprint focuses on maintaining claw health through proper nutrition, regular trimming, and environmental enrichment. Provide scratching posts and pads to help your cat naturally shed claw sheaths. Consider adding omega-3 fatty acids to their diet for stronger claws. Monitor for overgrowth or splitting, which can be more common during seasonal changes.
key_takeaways: Check claws weekly for overgrowth or damage.
Provide multiple scratching surfaces to encourage natural shedding.
Adjust diet with supplements if claws appear brittle.
